item.title: Judge Rejects DOJ Push to Force Google Sell Ad X
item.description: A federal judge denies the DOJ’s request to divest Google’s Ad X exchange, opting for behavioral remedies that keep the platform but open it to rivals.

item.title: Judge Rules Google Won’t Sell AdX After Antitrust Trial
item.description: A federal judge declined to order Google to divest its AdX exchange, despite findings of illegal publisher lock‑ins, reshaping antitrust remedies.

item.title: Google Ad‑Tech Remedy: Judge Bans Self‑Preferencing
item.description: U.S. Judge Leonie Brinkema rejects Google’s breakup request, instead imposing a self‑preferencing ban on its ad‑tech arm to restore competition.

item.title: Google Buys 400 MW Geothermal from Fervo for Utah Hub
item.description: Google’s new 400 MW geothermal PPA with Fervo powers a Utah AI data center, showcasing enhanced geothermal tech and advancing its 2030 net‑zero goal.

item.title: Google Moves Pixel Production to Vietnam, India by 2027
item.description: Google will cease all Pixel manufacturing in China, relocating phones, watches and earbuds to Vietnam and India, with full transition slated for 2027.

item.title: Google Pet Memory: AI Pet ID for Gemini Smart Home
item.description: Google adds Pet Memory to Gemini for Home, letting Nest cameras identify individual pets and automatically adjust lighting, temperature, and alerts.

item.title: Google Gemini in Chrome UK
item.description: Google rolls out Gemini for Chrome in the UK with AI features and integration

item.title: Google Buys Solar Farm Output
item.description: Google buys entire output of Steel River Energy Center solar project to offset emissions

item.title: Pixel Watch 5 Leaked
item.description: Google Pixel Watch 5 leak reveals four case finishes ahead of launch

item.title: A24 Google AI Tools
item.description: A24 partners with Google to build AI tools for filmmaking, expanding entertainment possibilities
